Kit summary

Spirit CallBasicExclusive Lv.1
Removes 1 layer of a random buff from a single enemy, then deals 180% ATK DMG to them and restores self HP by 60% of the DMG dealt.
Ancient Lamp Lv.1Spirit Call: Removes all buffs from the target. Increases the HP restoration by 20% of this attack for every layer of buff removed, up to 100%. Meanwhile, this skill also restores the HP of the ally with the lowest current HP.
Spirit FountainActiveExclusive Lv.2
Makes the HP percentage of all allies the same as the ally with the most HP percentage.
Ancient Lamp Lv.2Spirit Fountain: Cleanses all attribute debuffs from all allies before restoration, then grants 1 layer of [Heal] for 2 turns.
CommendationPassive
Restores HP by 18% of Max HP to an ally and increases their ATK by 40% for 2 turns whenever this ally destroys an enemy target's [Shield] when Alahan survives. This effect can only be triggered up to once per turn.
DetachActiveExclusive Lv.3
Removes all enemies' [Shields], then deals 180% ATK DMG to all enemies with a 40% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn.
Ancient Lamp Lv.3Detach: Steals all enemies' [Shields] instead. Grants all allies a [Shield] by 20% of Alahan's Max HP for 2 turns after casting Detach.
